issues.title_en: Nearly 3,900 sq km in Cambodia contaminated by unexploded Thai ordnance
issues.summary: PHNOM PENH: One year after armed conflict along the Cambodia-Thailand border, Cambodian demining operators warn that explosive remnants of war left behind by the fighting continue to endanger civilians across seven provinces, with newly completed surveys identifying nearly 3,900 square kilometres of land contaminated by unexploded ordnance (UXO).
